title: 新易盛站上确认位、腾讯财报后大跌；A/H低开中光通信分化
summary: 截至09:58 CST，上证、深证、恒指和恒生科技分别约跌0.65%、0.85%、1.57%和2.03%。新易盛涨2.71%至162.50元并越过160元确认位，获得初步价格确认，但仍待板块相对强势与1.6T交付后续验证；腾讯控股跌5.31%至353.00港元，回避结论强化。中际旭创涨1.26%但未越过404.67元，天孚通信跌0.48%且未越过111.60元；08:42首发截止后未发现改变判断的新增重大政策或公告。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美股分化、美元走强，油金铜同步回落
11月18日道指跌0.84%、标普500跌0.07%、纳指涨0.46%；美元指数升至103.81。WTI跌4.39%至82.23美元，黄金、白银和铜分别跌2.86%、4.72%和4.69%，资源链与高估值资产均受压。 来源
政策
证监会澄清基金经理须上报全部AI敞口传闻
证监会11月18日明确表示，没有要求基金经理上报所有产品AI行业敞口。澄清有助于降低交易性恐慌，但不改变高估值AI链对业绩与资金面的敏感性。 来源
政策
中澳钢铁脱碳对话推进标准与碳核算互认
工信部披露双方围绕绿色低碳标准、认证验证和碳核算互认展开交流，为钢铁节能改造、检测认证和绿色装备提供中期线索，落地仍取决于后续项目。 来源
政策
APEC演讲强调现代产业体系与新兴、未来产业
11月18日主旨演讲提出推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合，支持传统产业升级、新兴产业壮大和未来产业前瞻布局；属于中长期方向，不等于个股短线订单。 来源
科技
重庆国资发布AI场景，15个项目带动投资超30亿元
重庆市国资委发布市属国企AI应用场景与能力清单，15个签约项目预计带动科技创新投资超30亿元，覆盖交通、物流、实验室与装备场景，后续看预算执行和验收。 来源
科技
隔夜消费与网络安全领涨，贵金属和医疗领跌
Moomoo 11月19日08:37快照显示百货、服装零售、家具家电行业分别涨6.09%、5.97%、4.52%；概念榜网络安全涨5.56%。铜、黄金和医疗计划分别跌6.50%、5.78%、8.34%。 来源
科技
英伟达财报后冲高回落，AI链分歧扩大
英伟达销售展望高于市场预期，股价一度涨约2.7%，但因董事会否决Jensen重新任职相关消息转跌约2.4%；最新延时行情约跌2.96%，说明需求亮点未消除治理折价。 来源
财报
腾讯收入增长但利润指标承压
腾讯三季度收入2073.36亿元、同比增8%；经营利润591.47亿元、同比降7%，非国际财务报告准则利润665.19亿元、同比降6%。截至09:58延时行情报353.00港元、跌5.31%，财报后出现明显负面价格反馈。 来源
公司
新易盛澄清未削减需求预期，1.6T进入量产爬坡
公司11月18日公告称不存在订单取消或下调需求预期，1.6T产品处于量产爬坡。截至09:58延时行情报162.50元、涨2.71%，已越过160元确认位，但仍待板块相对强势与后续交付披露验证。 来源
公司
天孚通信CPO配套产品已批量交付
公司披露CPO配套产品已进入批量交付，预计2027年逐步提量，并已累计回购88万股、金额约1.08亿元。11月18日股价涨4.60%，但公告后的交易确认尚未发生。 来源
公司
中际旭创提出20亿至40亿元回购建议
董事长提议公司以20亿至40亿元回购股份，用于激励、员工持股或维护价值；11月18日股价涨0.84%至396.30元。金额、价格上限和实施节奏仍待正式方案及公告后交易验证。 来源

美股夜盘行情总结

1
夜盘指数
11月18日现金时段道指-0.84%、标普500-0.07%、纳指+0.46%；截至08:25 CST，DIA、SPY、QQQ延时代理分别约-1.10%、-0.28%、+0.39%，指数分化而非全面风险偏好回升。 来源
2
板块对照
百货、服装零售和网络安全领涨；医疗计划、铜、黄金和白银领跌。光通信概念涨2.37%，但其7涨12跌2平，内部并非普涨。
3
A/H 映射
美股光通信与CPO三家公司公告形成正向线索；截至09:58，新易盛+2.71%并越过160元确认位，中际旭创+1.26%但未越过404.67元，天孚通信-0.48%且未越过111.60元。恒生科技-2.03%、腾讯-5.31%显示港股风险偏好进一步走弱。

增量复核结论

事实：截至09:58延时行情，上证、深证、恒指和恒生科技分别约-0.65%、-0.85%、-1.57%和-2.03%；新易盛+2.71%，腾讯-5.31%。

判断：新易盛越过160元仅构成初步价格确认，仍待光通信相对强势与1.6T交付验证；腾讯明显弱于恒生科技，回避结论强化。

不确定性：行情为云端延时快照；AKShare仍仅代表11月18日收盘。08:42首发截止后未发现改变判断的新增重大政策或公告。

重点个股关注

天孚通信
300394.SZ
条件关注
事实与状态：CPO配套产品已批量交付、累计回购约1.08亿元；截至09:58报108.89元、跌0.48%，尚未越过111.60元确认位。
确认条件：公告后放量突破111.60元，并继续跑赢CPO板块；2027年提量节奏获得订单或财报验证。
风险与失效条件：若跌破106.20元、客户验证或扩产不及预期，条件关注失效。
中际旭创
300308.SZ
条件关注
事实与状态：董事长提出20亿至40亿元回购建议；截至09:58报401.30元、涨1.26%，有正反馈但仍未越过404.67元确认位。
确认条件：正式回购方案明确资金来源与价格上限，股价放量站上404.67元并维持相对强势。
风险与失效条件：若方案缩减、执行延迟或跌破385.72元，事件逻辑失效。
新易盛
300502.SZ
条件关注·初步确认
事实与状态：公司澄清无订单取消或需求预期下调，1.6T量产爬坡；截至09:58报162.50元、涨2.71%，已越过160元确认位。
后续确认：继续跑赢光通信概念，并由后续披露验证1.6T交付进度；当前不因单一价位突破升级为无条件看多。
风险与失效条件：若回落至160元下方、需求或良率低于预期，撤销初步确认并维持观望。
腾讯控股
00700.HK
回避
事实与状态：收入同比增8%，但经营利润和非IFRS利润分别降7%和6%；截至09:58报353.00港元、跌5.31%，负面价格反馈显著强化。
重新评估条件：财报后站回376港元且量价显示承接，利润率与资本开支路径得到更清晰验证。
风险与失效条件：若继续弱于恒生科技或利润压力扩大，维持回避；当前不构成多头信号。

板块轮动看板

受益方向

网络安全、零售修复及光通信相对强势；钢铁脱碳与国资AI场景提供中期政策线索。

观察方向

新易盛已越过160元但仍待板块相对强势；中际与天孚仍低于各自确认位。

压力方向

恒生科技跌2.03%，腾讯跌5.31%；金属与医疗的隔夜弱势仍压制风险偏好。

验证信号

新易盛能否守住160元，天孚能否越过111.60元，中际能否越过404.67元；腾讯仅在重返376港元后再评估。

逻辑链

美股网络安全与消费领涨 → 风险偏好从大盘科技向事件与消费分散 → A/H对应方向需开盘后确认。
英伟达指引超预期但股价回落 → 需求与治理折价并存 → AI链不能只按业绩标题交易。
CPO批量交付、需求澄清与回购提议 → 光通信业务线索增强 → 公告后价格和订单兑现仍是硬验证。
金属价格与相关行业同步下跌 → 资源股盈利预期承压 → 港股风险偏好偏弱，避免逆势包装。

风险雷达

英伟达财报后冲高回落且治理不确定性扩大，AI链估值波动可能传导至A/H。
铜、黄金、白银与医疗行业显著下跌，跨资产去风险仍在。
腾讯经营与非IFRS利润下降，财报后跌5.31%，明显负面反馈不得包装为多头。
AKShare仍仅为11月18日收盘基线；09:58行情为云端延时快照，不等同实时成交指令。
新易盛单一价位突破尚不足以替代板块相对强势、客户导入与1.6T交付验证。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Reuters全球市场（11月19日早间CST）、证监会、工信部、APEC、国务院国资委、港交所腾讯业绩公告、巨潮资讯及公司公告、GitHub Actions Moomoo快照（08:37 CST）和东方财富云端延时行情（09:58 CST）。AKShare v2抓取于2026-11-18 15:29 CST，仅作前一交易日基线。09:15增量复核：08:42首发截止，09:58复核；实质增量2项，进入正文2项；未发现改变判断的新增重大政策或公告。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes importance, not percentage change.
Major News
Global
US stocks diverged as the dollar rose and oil, gold and copper fell
On Nov. 18, the Dow fell 0.84%, the S&P 500 slipped 0.07% and the Nasdaq gained 0.46%; the dollar index rose to 103.81. WTI dropped 4.39% to $82.23, while gold, silver and copper fell 2.86%, 4.72% and 4.69%. Source
Policy
CSRC denied requiring funds to report all AI exposure
The CSRC said on Nov. 18 that it had not asked fund managers to report AI exposure across all products. The clarification may reduce trading anxiety but does not remove earnings and positioning risks for richly valued AI names. Source
Policy
China-Australia steel dialogue explored standards and carbon-accounting recognition
MIIT said the talks covered green standards, certification, verification and mutual recognition of carbon accounting, offering a medium-term signal for efficiency upgrades, testing and green equipment. Source
Policy
APEC speech stressed a modern industrial system and future industries
The Nov. 18 speech called for deeper integration of technology and industry, upgrading traditional sectors and fostering emerging and future industries. This is a strategic direction, not a near-term company order. Source
Tech
Chongqing SOEs unveiled AI scenarios tied to more than RMB3bn of investment
The municipal SASAC released AI opportunity and capability lists; 15 signed projects are expected to drive more than RMB3bn of technology investment across transport, logistics, labs and equipment. Source
Tech
Retail and cybersecurity led while metals and healthcare lagged
Moomoo's 08:37 CST snapshot showed department stores, apparel retail and furnishings up 6.09%, 5.97% and 4.52%; cybersecurity rose 5.56%. Copper, gold and healthcare plans fell 6.50%, 5.78% and 8.34%. Source
Tech
Nvidia reversed after earnings as AI leadership uncertainty widened
Sales guidance beat expectations and the shares initially gained about 2.7%, but they later fell about 2.4% after a report that the board rejected Jensen's return; the latest delayed quote was down roughly 2.96%. Source
Earnings
Tencent revenue grew while profit metrics weakened
Third-quarter revenue rose 8% to RMB207.336bn, operating profit fell 7% to RMB59.147bn and non-IFRS profit fell 6% to RMB66.519bn. At 09:58 delayed trading, the shares were HK$353.00, down 5.31%, a clear negative post-earnings response. Source
Company
Eoptolink denied demand cuts as 1.6T enters volume ramp
The company said there were no order cancellations or lower demand expectations and that 1.6T products were ramping. At 09:58 delayed trading, shares were RMB162.50, up 2.71% and above the RMB160 trigger, but sector-relative strength and follow-up delivery evidence remain pending. Source
Company
TFC said CPO components had entered volume delivery
The company said CPO components were in volume delivery and should scale from 2027; it had repurchased 880,000 shares for about RMB108m. Shares rose 4.60% on Nov. 18, but there is no post-announcement session yet. Source
Company
Zhongji Innolight chairman proposed an RMB2bn–4bn buyback
The proposal would support incentives, an employee plan or value maintenance. Shares rose 0.84% to RMB396.30 on Nov. 18; size, price ceiling, execution and post-announcement price confirmation remain pending. Source

Overnight US Market

1
Index tape
The Dow fell 0.84%, the S&P 500 slipped 0.07% and the Nasdaq gained 0.46% in the Nov. 18 cash session. At 08:25 CST, delayed DIA, SPY and QQQ proxies were about -1.10%, -0.28% and +0.39%, pointing to divergence rather than broad risk-on. Source
2
Sector contrast
Department stores, apparel retail and cybersecurity led; healthcare plans, copper, gold and silver lagged. Optical communication rose 2.37%, but breadth was only 7 up, 12 down and 2 unchanged.
3
A/H mapping
US optical strength and three CPO disclosures were constructive signals. At 09:58, Eoptolink was up 2.71% above its RMB160 trigger; Zhongji was up 1.26% but below RMB404.67, while TFC was down 0.48% below RMB111.60. Hang Seng Tech at -2.03% and Tencent at -5.31% showed weaker Hong Kong risk appetite.

Incremental Review Conclusion

Fact: At 09:58 delayed trading, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hang Seng and Hang Seng Tech were about -0.65%, -0.85%, -1.57% and -2.03%; Eoptolink was +2.71% and Tencent -5.31%.

Judgment: Eoptolink's move above RMB160 is only initial price confirmation pending optical-sector outperformance and 1.6T delivery evidence; Tencent lagged Hang Seng Tech, strengthening the avoid case.

Uncertainty: Quotes are delayed cloud snapshots and AKShare still reflects only the Nov. 18 close. No new policy or disclosure after the 08:42 cutoff changed the thesis.

Stocks to Watch

TFC Optical Communication
300394.SZ
Conditional watch
CPO components are in volume delivery and buybacks total about RMB108m; at 09:58 shares were RMB108.89, down 0.48% and below the RMB111.60 trigger.
Confirm only on a volume-backed break above RMB111.60, continued CPO outperformance and evidence supporting the 2027 ramp.
Invalid if shares fall below RMB106.20 or customer validation and capacity expansion disappoint.
Zhongji Innolight
300308.SZ
Conditional watch
The chairman proposed an RMB2bn–4bn buyback; at 09:58 shares were RMB401.30, up 1.26%, a positive response but still below the RMB404.67 trigger.
Confirm only after funding and the price ceiling are disclosed and shares break RMB404.67 on volume.
Invalid if the plan is reduced or delayed, or shares fall below RMB385.72.
Eoptolink Technology
300502.SZ
Conditional · initial confirmation
The company denied order cancellations or lower demand expectations and said 1.6T was ramping; at 09:58 shares were RMB162.50, up 2.71% and above RMB160.
Further confirmation requires optical-sector outperformance and follow-up evidence on 1.6T delivery; a single price break is not an unconditional bullish upgrade.
Revoke initial confirmation below RMB160 or if demand, yield or delivery falls short.
Tencent Holdings
00700.HK
Avoid
Revenue rose 8%, but operating and non-IFRS profit fell 7% and 6%; at 09:58 shares were HK$353.00, down 5.31%, materially strengthening the negative price signal.
Reassess only above HK$376 with clear demand and better visibility on margins and capex.
Maintain avoid if it keeps lagging the Hang Seng Tech Index or profit pressure expands; this is not a bullish signal.

Sector Rotation

Beneficiaries

Cybersecurity, retail and optical communication relative strength; green steel and SOE AI projects offer medium-term policy signals.

Watch

Eoptolink moved above RMB160 but still needs sector-relative strength; Zhongji and TFC remain below their triggers.

Pressure

Hang Seng Tech fell 2.03% and Tencent 5.31%; overnight metals and healthcare weakness still pressure risk appetite.

Validation

Watch whether Eoptolink holds RMB160, TFC clears RMB111.60 and Zhongji clears RMB404.67; reassess Tencent only above HK$376.

Logic Chain

US cybersecurity and retail strength → risk dispersed away from mega-cap tech → A/H proxies still need opening confirmation.
Nvidia guidance beat but shares reversed → demand strength and governance discount coexist → AI cannot trade on headlines alone.
CPO delivery, demand clarification and buyback proposal → stronger optical business signals → post-announcement price and order execution remain hard checks.
Metals and related industries fell together → resource earnings expectations weaken → do not repackage the move as bullish.

Risk Radar

Nvidia reversed after earnings as governance uncertainty widened, raising spillover risk for A/H AI valuations.
Copper, gold, silver and healthcare industries declined sharply, indicating ongoing cross-asset de-risking.
Tencent operating and non-IFRS profit fell and the shares dropped 5.31% after results; this negative signal must not be framed as bullish.
AKShare remains a Nov. 18 close baseline; the 09:58 cloud quote is delayed and is not a real-time trading instruction.
Eoptolink's single price break does not replace sector-relative strength, customer adoption or 1.6T delivery verification.

Sources and Timestamps

Sources: Reuters global markets; CSRC, MIIT, APEC and SASAC; Tencent's HKEX filing; CNINFO and company disclosures; the GitHub Actions Moomoo snapshot at 08:37 CST; and Eastmoney delayed cloud quotes at 09:58 CST. AKShare v2 was captured at 15:29 CST on Nov. 18 and remains only a prior-session baseline. The 09:15 review used the 08:42 publication cutoff and rechecked at 09:58: two material price-feedback items were found and both entered the brief; no new major policy or disclosure changed the thesis.
